purpose: Test the SEC Form 4 insider-purchase sleeve as a causal conditional overlay on the frozen breadth-20 cash-conversion leader, since Step 125 only tested it as a static-weight blend and found no static allocation beat the control.
selection_note: The single window/breadth/floor/sector-cap combination is fixed to the values Step 125 found robust across its own family variants, rather than re-searching all 480 Form4 structures, to avoid compounding a second layer of retrospective selection on top of an already-searched signal.
known_limitations: The Form4 sleeve's own weekly simulator has no adverse missing-price scenario, unlike the growth and cash-conversion sleeves; only the base scenario is modeled for it.

The Form4 signal itself was already chosen from a 480-structure search in Step 125; this experiment only searches the smaller conditional-overlay grid on top of three predeclared, non-cherry-picked structures.
